def VTask.greatestOfBdd {P : ℤ → Prop} [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z, P z → z ≤ b) (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) : { ub // P ub ∧ ∀ z, P z → z ≤ ub } :=
  let H_exists_initial : ∃ z'', z'' ≤ b ∧ P z'' :=
    let ⟨z, h_pz⟩ := Hinh in ⟨z, Hb z h_pz, h_pz⟩
  in
  let H_above_initial : ∀ z', z' > b → ¬ P z' :=
    λ z' h_gt, λ h_pz', int.not_lt_of_le (Hb z' h_pz') h_gt
  in
  let rec helper (z : ℤ)
           (H_above : ∀ z', z' > z → ¬ P z')
           (H_exists : ∃ z'', z'' ≤ z ∧ P z'') :
           { m // P m ∧ ∀ z', P z' → z' ≤ m } :=
    if h_p : P z then
      ⟨z, ⟨h_p, λ z' h_pz', λ h_gt, (H_above z' h_gt).elim h_pz'⟩⟩
    else
      let ⟨z'', h_z''_le_z, h_pz''⟩ := H_exists in
      have h_z''_le_z_minus_1 : z'' ≤ z - 1,
        begin
          cases le_total z'' z with h_le h_gt,
          { cases h_le with h_eq h_lt,
            { -- z'' = z
              have h_pz : P z := h_eq ▸ h_pz'',
              contradiction },
            { -- z'' < z
              exact int.le_of_lt_succ h_lt } },
          { -- z'' > z, but H_exists says z'' ≤ z. Contradiction.
            exfalso,
            exact h_gt h_z''_le_z } },
        end
      let H_above_new : ∀ z', z' > z - 1 → ¬ P z' :=
        λ z' h_gt,
        let h_ge : z' ≥ z := int.le_of_lt_succ h_gt in
        match le_iff_eq_or_lt.1 h_ge with
        | Or.inl h_eq => h
        | Or.inr h_gt_z => H_above z' h_gt_z
        end
      in
      helper (z - 1) H_above_new ⟨z'', h_z''_le_z_minus_1, h_pz''⟩
  in
  helper b H_above_initial H_exists_initial
